crossRefs.note: But Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh remained alive of those men who went to spy out the land.
For Yahweh had said of them, “They shall surely die in the wilderness.” There was not a man left of them, except Caleb…
except Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun, because they have followed Yahweh…

people.name: Caleb
people.line: Faithful spy, given Hebron as inheritance

people.name: Jephunneh
people.line: The Kenizzite, father of Caleb the spy.

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: surely you shall not come into the land concerning which I swore that I would make you dwell therein, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
translations.bsb: Surely none of you will enter the land in which I swore to settle you, except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.
translations.kjv: Doubtless ye shall not come into the land, concerning which I sware to make you dwell therein, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
translations.asv: surely ye shall not come into the land, concerning which I sware that I would make you dwell therein, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
